programme.desc: 劇集改編自紀靜蓉的小說如果奔跑是我的宿命，由鍾楚曦楊超越許娣陳小藝侯雯元領銜主演 該劇透過一場車禍，講述了兩個家庭如何在人生的逆境中展現出不同的生活態度和勇氣ampltbrampgt一次喜慶的壽宴後，一場意外的車禍對趙秀麗（陳小藝飾）和趙秀芳（許娣飾）的家庭造成了破壞性的打擊趙秀麗的兒子是一名成績優異的高中生，但在這場事故中不幸喪生，大女兒陳若華（楊超越飾）逃過一劫；而趙秀芳的女兒程安心（鍾楚曦飾）是一位年輕的舞蹈教師，也在這次事故中重傷失去了雙腿陳若華為了幫助母親趙秀麗從悲痛中恢復過來，將她帶到了自己的學生宿舍然而，陳若華在照顧心碎的母親和處理與周凱澤（王宥鈞飾）的戀情之間，感到極大的壓力另一方面，趙秀芳為了振奮失望的女兒程安心和逃避現實的女婿秦峰（宋洋飾），決定開始之前從未成功過的減肥隨著時間的推移，陳若華在與母親的關係中逐漸找回平衡，解開了母女之間的矛盾趙秀芳也最終成功地減掉了體重，幫助程安心重新勇敢面對生活

programme.desc: 2025年，適逢民族英雄林則徐誕辰二百四十周年國家主席習近平在福州任職期間，保育了林則徐出生地的一系列遺跡他先後多次引用林則徐苟利國家生死以，豈因禍福避趨之的名句，號召國人把林則徐的民族精神和優秀品格繼承發揚下去ampltbrampgt林則徐：虎門銷煙以外是一部由香港電台出品的五集歷史人文紀錄片影片以香港視角出發，跨越三萬公里深入中國多省市（包括澳門廣東湖南福建浙江河南陝西甘肅新疆），更東渡日本，探尋虎門銷煙之外那個更為真實立體的林則徐ampltbrampgt林則徐虎門銷煙的壯舉固然永載史冊，但其光輝遠不止於此本紀錄片突破傳統敘事框架，不僅回顧林則徐虎門銷煙的功績，更深入挖掘他作為治水能臣嚴謹學者流放者與思想家的多面人生透過實地探訪專家訪談，並結合AI技術生成動畫重現歷史場景，影片呈現林則徐在禁煙海防水利邊疆開發等方面的卓越貢獻，並揭示其開眼看世界的深遠影響節目以細膩的鏡頭語言和情感敘述，串聯歷史與當下，展現林則徐精神的當代意義，值此民族英雄誕辰二百四十周年之際，向他獻上最誠摯的敬意本片由amplt香港電台ampgt贈播

programme.title: 如果奔跑是我的人生
programme.desc: 劇集改編自紀靜蓉的小說如果奔跑是我的宿命，由鍾楚曦楊超越許娣陳小藝侯雯元領銜主演 該劇透過一場車禍，講述了兩個家庭如何在人生的逆境中展現出不同的生活態度和勇氣ampltbrampgt一次喜慶的壽宴後，一場意外的車禍對趙秀麗（陳小藝飾）和趙秀芳（許娣飾）的家庭造成了破壞性的打擊趙秀麗的兒子是一名成績優異的高中生，但在這場事故中不幸喪生，大女兒陳若華（楊超越飾）逃過一劫；而趙秀芳的女兒程安心（鍾楚曦飾）是一位年輕的舞蹈教師，也在這次事故中重傷失去了雙腿陳若華為了幫助母親趙秀麗從悲痛中恢復過來，將她帶到了自己的學生宿舍然而，陳若華在照顧心碎的母親和處理與周凱澤（王宥鈞飾）的戀情之間，感到極大的壓力另一方面，趙秀芳為了振奮失望的女兒程安心和逃避現實的女婿秦峰（宋洋飾），決定開始之前從未成功過的減肥隨著時間的推移，陳若華在與母親的關係中逐漸找回平衡，解開了母女之間的矛盾趙秀芳也最終成功地減掉了體重，幫助程安心重新勇敢面對生活

programme.desc: 從端午節習俗切入，分為千古歸途萬物繁花心靈造像盛裝凡塵與子同行和歲月晨光6集，每集30分鐘全片以龍舟這個世界符號提煉中華優秀傳統文化元素，用中國故事，國際表達的方式，向全球傳遞底蘊深厚的中國智慧ampltbrampgt主創團隊介紹，龍舟將傳統與現代東方與西方進行連結，實現了五個首次呈現：首次從基因考古視野探究三皇五帝神話等中華民族的上古起源和根脈；首次呈現楚辭中描述的世界上最後一片野生紅花玉蘭的真容；首次展現臺灣地區與湖北秭歸一脈同源的屈氏後裔端午祭祀活動；首次披露誕生於中國的世界上第一張體育郵票龍舟競渡；首次以文獻證實中國龍舟競渡在國外的流播ampltbrampgt紀錄片創作歷時兩年多，主創團隊外拍行程跨越五大洲，先後在英國德國澳大利亞土耳其埃及日本墨西哥等12個國家實地拍攝，累計查閱文獻和資料約500萬字，採訪了國內外近30位各行業頂尖專家為呈現最優質的畫面，該片還充分利用AI3D掃描等前沿技術，將龍舟置身於廣博的大歷史空間，建立起歷史與當代的視覺知覺聯繫，傳承和弘揚中華民族特有的精神內涵本片由amplt湖北廣播電視台ampgt贈播

programme.title: 너의 이름은.

programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD小嫻（關秀媚）是一位頗負盛名的流行愛情小說家，有三個死黨，冰冰（楊梵），Laura（姚樂怡）和Natasia（苑瓊丹），幾位好朋友在經常在小嫻家聚會，一日，小嫻女友冰冰（楊梵）將車停泊在鄰居DANIEL（吳毅將）家門口，竟就此失蹤，其後被人發現棄屍海灘！富家子弟Daniel外表斯文俊朗兼有學識，但內心其實是變態色魔，不久前，他才幫助兩位好友逃獄，現在更變本加厲，追求更大的刺激小嫻的警察男朋友輝（張家輝）及夥伴寶文（朱茵）接手調查冰冰死亡的案件，在亳無線索之下，只好拜託以前香港第一色魔食人博士（黃秋生）協助破案博士對色魔的心態了如指掌，遂設計一局中局，使Daniel有機會將小嫻LauraNatasia脅持到他家準備施暴，而暗地裡，警方悄然包圍DANIEL家，欲一舉擒住Daniel，沒想到卻失敗了，小嫻陷入危機中

programme.desc: 秀怡駕駛，接載凱晴超怡港車北上，並約同慧儀入住珠海的五星級酒店，望着港珠澳大橋於泳池嬉水，價格還包括早晚自助餐！溫體牛由屠宰到上桌時間迅速，讓顧客食出肉材鮮味，價錢一定離地？跟主持往深圳火鍋店吃，鮮嫩得來花費亦化算吃完再到超市搜購肉食，切記生肉不許帶過境港島某雞蛋仔店製作用心，更推出加一蚊多一底優惠？另有精品朱古力飲買一送一着數眾人還到網紅餐廳一試人均近千元的四人餐，最終三三折埋單？

programme.title: 東坡家事28粵PG

programme.title: 高朋滿座166粵

programme.title: Deep, Down and Dirty: The Science of Soil
programme.desc: Gardening expert Chris Beardshaw explores where soil comes from, and what it is made of. It is an often misunderstood substance, with people sometimes dismissing it as dirt, so he reveals it as it has never been seen before using specialist microphotography, and highlights what makes it so essential to life. Research shows that humans are pushing this precious resource to its limit, and scientists are battling to find ways of preserving it for the future

programme.title: Lios Mhiri
programme.desc: Visual artist and horticulturalist Miri Gillies has made some changes in the garden, introducing her new indoor growing space. She visits island gardener Murdo Macdonald, who has created a beautiful and productive garden from scratch, and former colleague Louise Galloway, who gives her a tour of the research glasshouses at the Royal Botanic Garden in Edinburgh

programme.title: Hebridean Baker - Nordic Islands
programme.desc: Situated north of the Arctic Circle, the Lofoten Islands in Norway are famed for their dramatic mountain landscapes and cod fisheries. Coinneach arrives MacLeod in March during peak cod season, helping to unload the days catch and observing the stockfish drying process. He works with a local chef to create a fine-dining dish using the wind-dried cod, makes lefse, a traditional flatbread, and harvests seaweed. A dinner of Lofotlam, a globally protected local lamb, rounds off his visit

programme.title: Rrachd Foraging
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke explore plants that thrive at the edge of nature, from shoreline saltmarsh to city centre, sand dune to wild garden corner. Lucy visits a favourite east coast location to show Mary Ann Seabuckthorn what grows in shoreline dunes, where different enterprising companies make the most of the fruit. Plus, the pair spend time in Edinburghs Royal Botanic Garden

programme.title: Miann na Maighdinn-mara Mermaid Tales
programme.desc: Kate MacLeod, aka The Hebridean Mermaid, explores the hidden gems of the Hebrides, meeting tradition bearers with remarkable stories about the places she loves to visit the most, above and below the water. In this episode she comes across an interesting sea creature, known as a sunfish, which is native to tropical waters, but is likely to have been carried to the islands by the Gulf Stream. Swimming on its side, the sun heats its body and it feeds on jellyfish. She also journeys to Taransay, home of some of the most stunning and unique beaches in the Outer Hebrides. Once a thriving community, the island had three villages, but is now home to deer, seabirds and cattle.

programme.title: Faodail: Found
programme.desc: The Faodail Film Archive, which gathers lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s to the 1980s in the Outer Hebrides, storing the footage for future generations. The Cinema Sgre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online, and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gidhealtachd for contemporary audiences

programme.title: 他从火光中走来Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.desc: 嗨放派是一档奇趣实验类真人秀综艺节目，第三季主打真实的生存实验，六位艺人嘉宾将开启十天荒岛生存挑战，比如需要自食其力体验搭建帐篷自制淋浴间起火烧饭自制做饭器具等挑战，最后还要举行一场别开生面的海岛运动会，用最好玩的方式将科学实践到生活里头Have Fun returns for a third season! programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.

programme.title: The Cloth Story

programme.title: My Health, My Choice
programme.desc: My Health, My Choice explores daily practices, behaviors, and health issues, highlighting factors like attitudes, diet, environment, and relationships, and provides practical solutions.

programme.title: Joran Borneo
programme.desc: JORAN BORNEO,Majalah travelog dalam Bahasa Melayudialek tempatan ini bakal menjejaki lokasi-lokasi lubuk ikan di sekitar BORNEO. Siri ini akan dibawa oleh 2 pengacara tempatan dari Sarawak dan Sabah.

programme.title: Salam Nusantara
programme.desc: Mengungkap lebih banyak khazanah negeri Sarawak yang masih belum lagi diketahui oleh khalayak awam khasnya tentang perkembangan tamadun masyarakat majmuk Sarawak termasuklah umat Islam di negeri ini.

programme.title: Bridging Borneo
programme.desc: Bridging Borneo is a documentary series that features 6 bridges and the places of interest that it connects to along the Sarawak coastal road network. These bridges span over iconic rivers to bring communities closer, foster economic growth and make travel easier.

programme.title: Alunan Borneo
programme.desc: Alunan Borneo, sebuah travelog seorang anak seni untuk mengenali lebih dekat tentang muzikirama tradisi etnik di Bumi Kenyalang dan berkenalan dengan lebih dekat dengan etnik-etnik di Sarawak.

programme.title: The Human Odyssey
programme.desc: Dokumentari ini menelusuri kisah asal usul dan pengembaraan manusia sejagat dalam memahami siapa kita dan dari mana kita datang melalui lakonan semula dan rekaan visual yang menarik.

programme.title: Hilang
programme.desc: The murder of an undocumented teenager in the small town of Seri Daik brings Inspector Munir back to the birthplace he left 17 years ago. He runs into Yusof, a religious scholar whom Munir blames for the death of his sister during a failed exorcism.

programme.title: L TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: Aroma Malaysia
programme.desc: Aroma Malaysia menampilkan eksplorasi kulinari yang memperkenalkan hidangan tradisional dan tempatan, diperkaya dengan pengalaman pengembaraan merentasi pelbagai destinasi budaya

programme.title: DL World News
programme.desc: Delivers timely and in-depth coverage of key global events, focusing on international politics, economics, and societal changes, with a spotlight on the latest developments impacting the world today.

programme.desc: TVS Fillers delivers quick, engaging segments on Sarawakian culture, local trends, and more, keeping viewers entertained between programs.

programme.desc: Detik Dunia membawakan rangkuman berita antarabangsa, mengetengahkan perkembangan global serta kisah-kisah yang membentuk landskap dunia hari ini.

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Azzam, seorang pemuda yang berpegang teguh pada nilai-nilai Islam, berusaha menuntut ilmu sambil mengekalkan cinta kepada Tsuraya. Mereka menghadapi pelbagai ujian, konflik keluarga, dan rintangan sosial, namun keyakinan dan keimanan membimbing mereka menempuh cabaran cinta dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih 2
programme.desc: Lanjutan dari Ketika Cinta Bertasbih yang mengisahkan Azzam kembali ke Indonesia selepas 9 tahun belajar di Kairo. Walaupun sudah bergelar sarjana, dia sukar cari kerja dan dipengaruhi tekanan masyarakat. Sambil menambah pengalaman berniaga, Azzam juga berdepan konflik cinta apabila wanita yang dicintainya telah dipinang sahabatnya, sementara Eliana yang menyukainya sendiri belum dapat diterimanya sebagai pilihan hati.

Selepas ibunya berkahwin dengan lelaki licik, konflik antara Zharfa dan bapa tirinya semakin memuncak. Akhirnya, dia dihantar ke sebuah pesantren di pedalaman Jawa Barat, Indonesia, di mana wataknya terus berkembang dalam latar budaya dan agama yang kuat

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahandihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Azzam, seorang pemuda yang berpegang teguh pada nilai-nilai Islam, berusaha menuntut ilmu sambil mengekalkan cinta kepada Tsuraya. Mereka menghadapi pelbagai ujian, konflik keluarga, dan rintangan sosial, namun keyakinan dan keimanan membimbing mereka menempuh cabaran cinta dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih 2
programme.desc: Lanjutan dari Ketika Cinta Bertasbih yang mengisahkan Azzam kembali ke Indonesia selepas 9 tahun belajar di Kairo. Walaupun sudah bergelar sarjana, dia sukar cari kerja dan dipengaruhi tekanan masyarakat. Sambil menambah pengalaman berniaga, Azzam juga berdepan konflik cinta apabila wanita yang dicintainya telah dipinang sahabatnya, sementara Eliana yang menyukainya sendiri belum dapat diterimanya sebagai pilihan hati.

programme.title: Air Mata Terakhir Bunda
programme.desc: Seorang ibu berkorban demi anak-anaknya walaupun terpaksa menghadapi penderitaan dan perpisahan yang menyayat hati.

programme.title: Memory Lane
programme.desc: Kisah pasangan warga emas, Jaap dan Maartje, yang mengembara ke Sepanyol untuk bertemu sahabat lama. Perjalanan tersebut membuka kembali kenangan lama serta membantu mereka menemukan semula makna cinta dan hubungan mereka selepas bertahun bersama.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Zharfa
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan Zharfa, seorang gadis Malaysia yang penuh pemberontakan dan emosional, sejak ditinggalkan oleh ayah kandungnya ketika berusia satu tahun. Selepas ibunya berkahwin dengan lelaki licik, konflik antara Zharfa dan bapa tirinya semakin memuncak. Akhirnya, dia dihantar ke sebuah pesantren di pedalaman Jawa Barat, Indonesia, di mana wataknya terus berkembang dalam latar budaya dan agama yang kuat

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahandihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: Mars Met Venus Part Cewe
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Mila, seorang wanita yang mempunyai pandangan tersendiri mengenai hubungan dan cinta, yang berdepan dengan perbezaan cara berfikir antara lelaki dan wanita. Melalui kisah percintaan Mila dan Kelvin, filem ini memaparkan konflik, salah faham serta sisi lucu dalam hubungan pasangan sebelum melangkah ke alam perkahwinan.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
programme.desc: Irma, seorang wanita karier yang sukses dan banyak menolak lamaran lelaki demi menjaga ayahnya yang ia anggap sebagai pintu menuju surga selepas kematian ibunya. Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.title: Pelangi Yang Hilang
programme.desc: Cikgu Lutfi yang baru ditukarkan ke sekolah berusaha membantu Hadi dan adiknya yang kematian ibu, tetapi konflik timbul apabila ibu saudara mereka kembali dan menimbulkan masalah keluarga

programme.title: Langit
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: Mega Series Suara Hati Istri: Anjani
programme.desc: Anjani berkahwin dengan Ammar melalui perkahwinan yang diatur, namun malangnya Ammar tidak mencintai Anjani, terutamanya selepas mengetahui bahawa Anjani sukar untuk hamil. Akhirnya, Anjani mengambil anak angkat yang ternyata mempunyai rahsia masa lalu dalam kehidupan suaminya.

programme.title: Doyan Makan
programme.desc: Doyan Makan menjemput penonton untuk mengikuti perjalanan dan pengalaman kulinari untuk makanan popular di kawasan tersebut, serta akan meninjau informasi tentang tempat, harga dan proses penghasilan makanan yang mereka nikmati.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Siapa Takut Orang Ketiga
programme.desc: Kimi tiba di Swiss untuk memulakan hidup barunya dan di sana dia berkenalan dengan William, seorang pelajar Indonesia yang sedang menyelesaikan pengajiannya. William membantu Kimi mendapatkan pekerjaan. Samuel, sahabat Kimi di Indonesia, merasakan Kimi semakin dekat dengan William. Namun, Kimi menyangkal perkara itu. Hakikatnya, Kimi telah menyimpan perasaan kepada Samuel sejak lama.

programme.title: Bukan Cuma Khodam, Love Tester Kita Juga Cocok
programme.desc: Rani, seorang gadis cantik dan mandiri, yang pada suatu hari pergi ke pasar dan membeli santan yang dijual oleh Aris. Pertemuan ini menjadi awal dari kisah mereka.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Foodie Buddy
programme.desc: Program masakan dan kulinari yang meneroka keunikan serta kekayaan cita rasa hidangan Indonesia, menampilkan pelbagai sajian tradisional, ramuan tempatan dan pengalaman kulinari dari seluruh negara.

programme.title: Rindu Bukan Rindu
programme.desc: Rindu Bukan Rindu mengisahkan kisah seorang wanita bernama Rindu yang merasa bertuah memiliki seorang lelaki bernama Devan. Kedua-duanya tinggal di Jepun dan menghabiskan masa bersama. Devan sentiasa berada di dekat Rindu, melindungi dan mencintainya. Hubungan di antara mereka terasa sangat rapat dan sempurna. Tetapi suatu hari, Rindu melihat Devan memegang tangan seorang wanita lain. Apakah yang terjadi di antara mereka?

Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. programme.desc: Sebuah siri separa dokumentari yang menyeronokkan dan dikendalikan oleh sekumpulan hos cilik yang penuh tenaga. Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. programme.title: Severe Case Decoded Whats On Today
programme.desc: The program focuses on various serious illnesses, explaining their causes, pathological mechanisms, latest treatment options, and prevention methods in an accessible way. programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An Whats On Today
programme.desc: Queen Gu Qing played by Wang Yijin is framed and killed in a meticulously planned fire, only to be reborn in the body of Feng Qing played by Fang Jin, a maidservant at the Imperial Garment Bureau. Once a noble queen and now reduced to a lowly palace maid, Feng Qing refuses to be consumed by grief. Determined to protect her younger sister Gu Wan played by Wu Mansi, uncover the truth behind her own murder and bring the real culprit to justice, she chooses to conceal her sharpness and lie low in the depths of the palace under Feng Qings identity. Knowing that she cannot overturn the case on her own, Feng Qing secretly reaches out to her younger brother Gu Xuan played by Chu Zijun, who serves as an imperial physician. With a deep mutual understanding, the siblings form an alliance and use their respective strengths to navigate the power struggles within the harem. While avoiding repeated schemes and traps, they gather clues and outwit the treacherous forces lurking in the palace. As revenge and protection become entwined in this dangerous game, Feng Qing inevitably crosses paths once again with Emperor Xiao Luo played by Zhao Huawei. Xiao Luo has always harbored doubts about Gu Qings tragic death and senses traces of Gu Qing in Feng Qing, prompting him to test her repeatedly. Feng Qing, meanwhile, is filled with complex emotions toward Xiao Luo. Through their repeated confrontations and emotional push-and-pull, the two gradually unravel past misunderstandings, while the bond left unresolved in their previous life quietly begins again.

programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An Whats On Today
programme.desc: Queen Gu Qing played by Wang Yijin is framed and killed in a meticulously planned fire, only to be reborn in the body of Feng Qing played by Fang Jin, a maidservant at the Imperial Garment Bureau. Once a noble queen and now reduced to a lowly palace maid, Feng Qing refuses to be consumed by grief. Determined to protect her younger sister Gu Wan played by Wu Mansi, uncover the truth behind her own murder and bring the real culprit to justice, she chooses to conceal her sharpness and lie low in the depths of the palace under Feng Qings identity. Knowing that she cannot overturn the case on her own, Feng Qing secretly reaches out to her younger brother Gu Xuan played by Chu Zijun, who serves as an imperial physician. With a deep mutual understanding, the siblings form an alliance and use their respective strengths to navigate the power struggles within the harem. While avoiding repeated schemes and traps, they gather clues and outwit the treacherous forces lurking in the palace. As revenge and protection become entwined in this dangerous game, Feng Qing inevitably crosses paths once again with Emperor Xiao Luo played by Zhao Huawei. Xiao Luo has always harbored doubts about Gu Qings tragic death and senses traces of Gu Qing in Feng Qing, prompting him to test her repeatedly. Feng Qing, meanwhile, is filled with complex emotions toward Xiao Luo. Through their repeated confrontations and emotional push-and-pull, the two gradually unravel past misunderstandings, while the bond left unresolved in their previous life quietly begins again.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded Whats On Today

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An Whats On Today
programme.desc: Queen Gu Qing played by Wang Yijin is framed and killed in a meticulously planned fire, only to be reborn in the body of Feng Qing played by Fang Jin, a maidservant at the Imperial Garment Bureau. Once a noble queen and now reduced to a lowly palace maid, Feng Qing refuses to be consumed by grief. Determined to protect her younger sister Gu Wan played by Wu Mansi, uncover the truth behind her own murder and bring the real culprit to justice, she chooses to conceal her sharpness and lie low in the depths of the palace under Feng Qings identity. Knowing that she cannot overturn the case on her own, Feng Qing secretly reaches out to her younger brother Gu Xuan played by Chu Zijun, who serves as an imperial physician. With a deep mutual understanding, the siblings form an alliance and use their respective strengths to navigate the power struggles within the harem. While avoiding repeated schemes and traps, they gather clues and outwit the treacherous forces lurking in the palace. As revenge and protection become entwined in this dangerous game, Feng Qing inevitably crosses paths once again with Emperor Xiao Luo played by Zhao Huawei. Xiao Luo has always harbored doubts about Gu Qings tragic death and senses traces of Gu Qing in Feng Qing, prompting him to test her repeatedly. Feng Qing, meanwhile, is filled with complex emotions toward Xiao Luo. Through their repeated confrontations and emotional push-and-pull, the two gradually unravel past misunderstandings, while the bond left unresolved in their previous life quietly begins again.

programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

The program blends travel, cuisine, and culture, inviting viewers not only to taste but also to experience the stories, people, and places behind Taiwanese food and destinations. Through lively food challenges, scenic explorations, and authentic local encounters, the hosts bring audiences closer to Taiwans diverse flavors and vibrant traditions.

Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: The first spy thriller movie by famous Director Zhang Yi Mou, this film follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret operation in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo in 1932. Sold out by a traitor, the agents, who split up into two teams, find themselves surrounded by threats on all sides. Can they complete their mission?

programme.title: Its A Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: Kid from the Big Apple 2, The
programme.desc: Sarah and her mother return to Malaysia to reunite with her retired grandfather. What begins as a warm homecoming turns bittersweet as they notice signs of dementia, with his memories and sense of self fading. As they navigate confusion and emotional strain, the family learns to support one another with patience and love.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: When a decade-long tunnel project is about to complete, an earthquake strikes and leads to a series of subsidence and landslides. The tunnel and a nearby town are at stake. A retired soldier and his son step up to try and stop the disasters at source. Will the authority decide to blow up the tunnel to save the 160,000 people in town?

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, one of the security escorts, Jelly, steals the diamonds and flees. Fellow security escorts, Yau Shing and Penguin, are forced to help the robber track down the diamonds. They stumble onto a remote village along the way, encountering strange villagers and mysterious incidents. Can they finally locate Jelly and the diamonds?

programme.title: Detective vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths. Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real Chosen Sleuth instead of a lunatic.

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Extended Version
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: We are Family
programme.desc: Struggling as an extra, Chi Kwong joins a rent-a-family company run by Carlos and aspiring actress Catherine, and rent themselves out as make-believe relatives. As they surrogate different families, they unravel the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way.

programme.title: Stuntman
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friends final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: Facing skyrocketing rent and dwindling customers, a middle-aged internet caf owner assembles a ragtag team for a HK500,000 eSports tournament. He recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a dismissed pro gamer. What follows is an impossible battleone that finally lets these dreamers fight with no regrets.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a law graduate overwhelmed by despair after failing the bar exam three times and vents his frustration on a drunken passenger one stormy night. Twenty years later, Meng is a successful lawyer, but his investigation into a sexual assault case involving a young girl rekindles haunting memories he cannot escape.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty, and their fathers drug addiction. Initially, the sisters attempt to appease him, but as they enter adolescence, they ultimately rebel and escape. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Ready OR Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not?

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the citys renowned Dumpling Queen.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize. However, what Kao and other contestants do not realize is that there is a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground who wants to eat them all!

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack, but luckily cyber security engineer Chun, manages to fend it off with his protective firewall system. To Chuns surprise, his boss is the mastermind of the attack, and when Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Zun Fei becomes the right-hand man to Macau tycoon Huang, whose hands are deep in both legal and illegal businesses. However, facing underworld violence, power struggles and moral dilemmas, Fei is torn between love and justice. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a deadly gamble set against him, with his life at stake.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Evas mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mothers wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Evas heart?

programme.title: Song Of Spring
programme.desc: An 85-year-old mother lives with her 65-year-old daughter who is suffering from Alzheimers disease, causing her to suffer a decline in memory, mental confusion and disorientation. Though the elderly mother has to shoulder the burden of a caregiver, she still wants to be with her daughter forever.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brothers Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her fathers towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her fathers debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly Iron Fist technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army.

programme.title: Cat vs Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fishermans honour but accidentally kills the governors son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the rivers edge, he is rescued by the fishermans daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xus until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mus lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Lis father

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: 生活智多星第1812集
programme.desc: 人間衛視生活智多星邀請到好門媳婦－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上智多星本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解生活智多星內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射充滿元氣的不老傳說以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，生活智多星全面關心

programme.title: 生活智多星第1813集
programme.desc: 人間衛視生活智多星邀請到好門媳婦－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上智多星本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解生活智多星內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射充滿元氣的不老傳說以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，生活智多星全面關心

programme.title: 人間新聞

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第7集
programme.desc: 風月同天此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫共度風雨影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影以行動，讓愛無國界這，就是慈濟一個由無數人的小善匯聚成世界之光的故事

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第199集
programme.desc: 什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間在手術室在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？ 志為人醫守護愛帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親 以病為師的堅持病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人

programme.title: senay345第2季:第143集
programme.desc: 一起唱出具有渲染力的文化音符，族語童謠裡述說的是我們的根，全新型態的兒童少年節目senay345，將透過活潑創新的兒童音樂節目形式，提供不同族群孩童一個享受展演的舞台每一集會邀請二位孩童，在節目中演唱族語歌曲，聽著小朋友說著族語故事，透過童趣的自然對話與互動激發創作力和表達能力，一起感受到純粹快樂自然的沉浸在族語世界裡

programme.title: pito pitju mpitu 7個為什麼?第1季:第65集
programme.desc: 我們去學校上課囉！ 這一季我們帶著六個動畫人物走進校園，去到教學阿美語排灣語泰雅語布農語還有太魯閣語的五個族群語言的學校，跟著族語老師與小小朋友們一起上課一起唱歌，呈現俏皮與新穎的族語教學方式在課堂中認識書寫文字的發音，還有複習每集的主要單字

programme.title: Kari Snruwan紀時光第1季:第16集

programme.title: senay345第2季:第145集
programme.desc: 一起唱出具有渲染力的文化音符，族語童謠裡述說的是我們的根，全新型態的兒童少年節目senay345，將透過活潑創新的兒童音樂節目形式，提供不同族群孩童一個享受展演的舞台每一集會邀請二位孩童，在節目中演唱族語歌曲，聽著小朋友說著族語故事，透過童趣的自然對話與互動激發創作力和表達能力，一起感受到純粹快樂自然的沉浸在族語世界裡

programme.title: pito pitju mpitu 7個為什麼?第1季:第67集
programme.desc: 我們去學校上課囉！ 這一季我們帶著六個動畫人物走進校園，去到教學阿美語排灣語泰雅語布農語還有太魯閣語的五個族群語言的學校，跟著族語老師與小小朋友們一起上課一起唱歌，呈現俏皮與新穎的族語教學方式在課堂中認識書寫文字的發音，還有複習每集的主要單字

programme.title: 大自然生趣第32集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道南路鷹一萬死九千這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，大自然生趣 大自然生趣，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味很湊巧的，生趣這兩個字，其實這是客語有趣的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是大自然真有趣這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 層層透視古文明第5季:第1集

programme.title: 我的男友是媽寶第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 本季媽寶們強勢回歸，麥特跟金姆的婚禮策劃與新屋工程都因為新冠肺炎疫情而停擺，凱莉又不斷想主導新屋規劃方面的決策，讓金姆感到頭疼沙奇伯與艾蜜莉分手半年後復合，兩人把這消息告訴萊拉，沒想到卻得到意外的回應布萊恩與翠絲交往十年終於要步入婚姻，但這位媽寶新郎竟邀請媽媽潔恩一起去蜜月旅行，翠絲聽聞後傻眼不已

programme.title: 無窮潛力第2季:第13集
programme.desc: 在本集節目裡，潔絲敏幫助洛杉磯的消防員艾倫與他太太達琳改造他們的房屋，這間房子位於絕佳的地段與住宅區，卻完全沒有反映出他們一家喜愛的海灘風格潔絲敏改造露臺，讓一家人能在屋外野餐放鬆，室內方面則打通了兩間起居室，拆掉廚房裡的柱子，為廚房設計超大中島，此外她還訂製了一張原木餐桌，加入宛若河川的桌面設計，整體前後呼應的全新海灘屋令這對夫妻驚呼連連

programme.title: 無窮潛力第2季:第14集
programme.desc: 本集的委託人喜歡提基風格，然而屋外的大片植物遮蔽自然光線，造成屋內陰暗，而且動線不佳，在潔絲敏的巧手下，結合屋主喜歡的提基風格與家的感覺，呈現溫馨又有特色的設計，讓屋主們大為讚嘆

programme.title: 100天造新家第4季:第7集

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 負擔得起高價婚紗的新娘，通常認為能輕易找到心目中的理想婚紗；然而藍迪要在此告訴你，即使預算無上限的新娘，挑選夢幻婚紗也會遇上困難新娘莉亞聽從嬌寵的小妹黛娜建議，而非自己的直覺，最終空手而歸準新娘克絲汀想破守舊家人的桎梏，而一件擁有美麗細部設計的馬甲婚紗，讓她如願以償梅開二度的新娘夏奈兒適合品尼娜托奈婚紗，再次挑選相同設計師婚紗的她保證，這絕對是最後一回了新娘萊莎想挑選第三套婚紗，但是挑剔的她卻因為無法找到能勝過先前兩件的款式，因而大失所望

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 今天藍迪將告訴大家，準新娘在選購婚紗之前，必須知道哪些事項，才能順利完成任務首先你要在踏進婚紗店之前便弄清楚預算；若是你一眼愛上第一件試穿的婚紗，別擔心，這絕對是件好事挑選婚紗時，要選擇適合自己身材的版型，但是不要過度拘泥心目中的理想款式；要記住，修改或增添配件都能帶來意想不到的驚喜然而修改或增添配件都會增加費用，要預留預算空間另外要相信自己的直覺，事先和親友團討論，以免在婚紗店各唱各調，結果空手而歸

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗第20季:第8集

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 負擔得起高價婚紗的新娘，通常認為能輕易找到心目中的理想婚紗；然而藍迪要在此告訴你，即使預算無上限的新娘，挑選夢幻婚紗也會遇上困難新娘莉亞聽從嬌寵的小妹黛娜建議，而非自己的直覺，最終空手而歸準新娘克絲汀想破守舊家人的桎梏，而一件擁有美麗細部設計的馬甲婚紗，讓她如願以償梅開二度的新娘夏奈兒適合品尼娜托奈婚紗，再次挑選相同設計師婚紗的她保證，這絕對是最後一回了新娘萊莎想挑選第三套婚紗，但是挑剔的她卻因為無法找到能勝過先前兩件的款式，因而大失所望

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 今天藍迪將告訴大家，準新娘在選購婚紗之前，必須知道哪些事項，才能順利完成任務首先你要在踏進婚紗店之前便弄清楚預算；若是你一眼愛上第一件試穿的婚紗，別擔心，這絕對是件好事挑選婚紗時，要選擇適合自己身材的版型，但是不要過度拘泥心目中的理想款式；要記住，修改或增添配件都能帶來意想不到的驚喜然而修改或增添配件都會增加費用，要預留預算空間另外要相信自己的直覺，事先和親友團討論，以免在婚紗店各唱各調，結果空手而歸

programme.title: 可愛動物大集合第1季:第19集

programme.title: 家有惡犬第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 我們忍不住愛上牠們，面對這些四條腿的家人，這是無條件的愛在本節目中人類最好的朋友惡行全都錄，宛如我們最可怕的敵人我們走遍全世界，尋找最壞的寵物，牠們為了食物乞討，四腳朝天甚至奮力爭取，若全都失敗，就直接從冰箱裡偷吃牠們是最誇張的愛吃狗某些愛吃狗令人嘆為觀止，比方說恰布斯嗜吃格子薯條自從麻吉還是幼犬，牠就擅長在最不尋常的地方找到食物另一個例子是小甜包，牠已經榮膺本周最壞的鑽石狗寵物通常讓一家人的感情更緊密，但同時牠們也能把你家拆了，牠們因此被稱為家中破壞王雖然波尼，阿雷和露納是本周最壞寵物的決選者，似乎提藍德一家人會永遠快樂地生活下去最後奪冠的是黏人狗卡蜜，牠對飼主死纏爛打

programme.desc: 泰瑞莎是美國種狗救援中心的員工她常和同事前往美國各州的犬隻繁殖場，救援那些一輩子都被關在籠子裡的種狗繁殖場的環境很糟為了方便管理，業主會將種狗關在狹小的籠子裡，以機器餵食這些種狗很少和人類或其他狗接觸，因此都不太社會化今天傑夫醫生帶著幾位同事來到泰瑞莎的救援中心，提供免費醫療服務，並分享他們得到的物資除了為這些可憐的狗檢查和醫療外，他們也帶回幾隻狗到診所讓人領養獸醫技師海克特也領養了一隻狗

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第4季:第7集
programme.desc: 泰瑞莎是美國種狗救援中心的員工她常和同事前往美國各州的犬隻繁殖場，救援那些一輩子都被關在籠子裡的種狗繁殖場的環境很糟為了方便管理，業主會將種狗關在狹小的籠子裡，以機器餵食這些種狗很少和人類或其他狗接觸，因此都不太社會化今天傑夫醫生帶著幾位同事來到泰瑞莎的救援中心，提供免費醫療服務，並分享他們得到的物資除了為這些可憐的狗檢查和醫療外，他們也帶回幾隻狗到診所讓人領養獸醫技師海克特也領養了一隻狗

programme.title: 家有惡犬第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 我們忍不住愛上牠們，面對這些四條腿的家人，這是無條件的愛在本節目中人類最好的朋友惡行全都錄，宛如我們最可怕的敵人我們走遍全世界，尋找最壞的寵物，牠們為了食物乞討，四腳朝天甚至奮力爭取，若全都失敗，就直接從冰箱裡偷吃牠們是最誇張的愛吃狗某些愛吃狗令人嘆為觀止，比方說恰布斯嗜吃格子薯條自從麻吉還是幼犬，牠就擅長在最不尋常的地方找到食物另一個例子是小甜包，牠已經榮膺本周最壞的鑽石狗寵物通常讓一家人的感情更緊密，但同時牠們也能把你家拆了，牠們因此被稱為家中破壞王雖然波尼，阿雷和露納是本周最壞寵物的決選者，似乎提藍德一家人會永遠快樂地生活下去最後奪冠的是黏人狗卡蜜，牠對飼主死纏爛打

programme.desc: 我們忍不住愛上牠們，面對這些四條腿的家人，這是無條件的愛人類最好的朋友惡行全都錄，宛如我們最可怕的敵人我們走遍全世界，尋找最壞的狗狗，所以請你坐好，我們即將倒數選出冠軍有時候我們的寵物聰明反被聰明誤，有時候牠們只顧吃飯，忘了用腦例如法國牛頭犬塔克斯進退兩難，這個小傢伙有難看的戽斗，當牠咬著飛盤,就成了睜眼瞎子老英國鬥牛犬魯賓通常頭先陷入僵局，討喜的哈士奇犬傑克斯通常是隻乖狗，但是今晚例外大衛與卡翠娜賽比斯瑪真的很疼愛髒兮兮的梅西，即使牠酷愛挖洞巴哥幼犬柔伊暫時在籠子裡關禁閉，因為牠在史密斯一家的地板上便溺貓咪科林犯下的不是小罪牠恐嚇賈斯汀哈洛可憐的凱阿姨聰明的英國鬥牛犬則因

programme.desc: 塞倫蓋提迷宮似的濱岸林是一隻母花豹的地盤，來去無蹤的牠在地盤上打獵，對牠的家族來說，牠提供照護，也勇敢守衛，這代表灌木叢裡有許多動物要面對死神驟降，但唯有這樣，小花豹才能在殘酷的棲地理存活下去請看花豹天后如何獵殺遷徙的牛羚，還要避開死對頭獅子，爭搶相同的資源一代又一代的小花豹誕生，母花豹持續為家庭努力付出，如果一切順利，有朝一日牠的女兒也會繼承牠的國度，成為濱岸林裡神出鬼沒的花豹天后

programme.title: MOMO歡樂谷第10季:第30集
programme.desc: 最適合小朋友觀賞的優質兒童律動節目除了好聽的歌曲及好看的唱跳表演，還有哥哥和姐姐們的遊戲大PK另透過說故事的啟發引導兒童們，為兒童們解答生活上和人際關係上的眾多疑惑

programme.title: 寶貝星樂園第5季:第30集
programme.desc: 寶貝星樂園，歡樂總動員！MOMO親子台特地開闢一個園地，讓2-12歲的小朋友可以在寶貝星樂園展現他們的才藝，秀出他們的熱情大方可以看到唱歌舞蹈樂器演奏等等不同小朋友的才藝，還有小朋友表演時自信投入的表現，以及家長們陪同練習在旁加油的溫馨畫面等等，節目氣氛歡樂又熱鬧！除了 邀請專業的評審老師給予建議講評之外，每集也會選出最佳造型獎最佳人氣獎以及閃亮小明星獎給予鼓勵，也能為小朋友們留下一個快樂的童年回憶，歡迎2 -12歲的小朋友們踴躍報名參加！

programme.desc: 最適合小朋友觀賞的優質兒童律動節目除了好聽的歌曲及好看的唱跳表演，還有哥哥和姐姐們的遊戲大PK另透過說故事的啟發引導兒童們，為兒童們解答生活上和人際關係上的眾多疑惑

programme.title: 寶貝星樂園第6季:第2集
programme.desc: 寶貝星樂園，歡樂總動員！MOMO親子台特地開闢一個園地，讓2-12歲的小朋友可以在寶貝星樂園展現他們的才藝，秀出他們的熱情大方可以看到唱歌舞蹈樂器演奏等等不同小朋友的才藝，還有小朋友表演時自信投入的表現，以及家長們陪同練習在旁加油的溫馨畫面等等，節目氣氛歡樂又熱鬧！除了 邀請專業的評審老師給予建議講評之外，每集也會選出最佳造型獎最佳人氣獎以及閃亮小明星獎給予鼓勵，也能為小朋友們留下一個快樂的童年回憶，歡迎2 -12歲的小朋友們踴躍報名參加！

programme.title: 紙箱做玩具第28集
programme.desc: 最好玩的DIY節目，趕快跟著哥哥姐姐一起來動手做玩具！ 家中一定都有不需要的紙箱，就把這些紙箱變成桌上型的迷你玩具吧！有：投籃機扭蛋機掌上型遊戲機好玩的對戰遊戲等，親子一起動手做全家人一起玩遊戲真是太有趣了

programme.title: 喵喵魔法盒第26集
programme.desc: Kit和Kate是一對兄妹，他們的家中有一個神奇魔法盒，放滿心愛的玩具和寶物兩兄妹最愛跳進神奇的魔法盒，出發去探險，每次遇到不同挑戰，兩隻活潑又頑皮的小貓咪懂得作出最正確的選擇嗎？

programme.title: Hello Kitty-Super Style！第137集
programme.desc: 在這部充滿樂趣與動感的劇集中，Hello Kitty 是櫻桃鎮的友善英雄，總是竭盡全力幫助朋友，帶來微笑與勇氣無論是克服恐懼學會分享，還是嘗試新事物，她都用善良和愛心展現超凡的力量當朋友需要幫助時，她將成為探險家偵探廚師歌星等角色，用智慧與勇氣解決問題Hello Kitty 的超級友誼精神團結了櫻桃鎮，讓小鎮更加溫暖有愛！

programme.title: 幫幫龍出動第72集
programme.desc: 在一個平和安寧的小鎮上，人類與恐龍生活在一起，但恐龍們總是會鬧出許多的問題，例如貪吃的速龍吃掉小朋友的早餐，龐大的雷龍碰倒馬路上的電線杆，劍龍媽媽的蛋不見了，等等這時候，維護恐龍小鎮安寧的幫幫龍小隊就會出動，幫忙協調人類與恐龍之間的矛盾，以及幫忙解決他們的困難在幫幫龍小隊的幫助下，小朋友們與恐龍成為朋友，一起在小鎮快樂地生活

programme.title: 豆豆先生第423集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通第6集
programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星兔寶寶太菲鴨傻大鳥崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界

programme.title: 湯姆貓與傑利鼠第107集
programme.desc: 湯姆貓和傑利鼠的主人要搬家了，牠們成了無家可歸的流浪漢，遇到了傷心的小女孩羅比，她的監護人菲格姨媽是一個壞心腸的女人，企圖侵吞羅比爸爸留下的億萬財產羅比逃出後，菲格姨媽為了抓到羅比，還想出了懸賞百萬捉拿的詭計還好羅比的爸爸趕了回來，菲格姨媽的陰謀破滅，而湯姆和傑瑞也有了更大更漂亮的房子，只是牠們之間的戰爭可沒那麼容易就結束呢！

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第16集
programme.desc: 故事圍繞著一個住在平凡城鎮卻一點也不平凡的搞怪家庭這個家庭的成員包括終日待在家中的家庭主夫身高六呎四寸的粉紅兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工廠上班的媽媽陶春嬌他們的孩子也很有特色，有藍色大頭貓阿甘和4歲天才小兔安安，以及原本是寵物金魚長了兩條腿後就變成家庭成員之一的阿達

programme.title: 豆豆先生第425集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通第36集
programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星兔寶寶太菲鴨傻大鳥崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界

programme.desc: 在美麗的布魯姆斯小鎮，有一群救援小英雄，分別是富有正義感的警車隊長-波力勇敢又可靠消防車-羅伊善良又聰明的救護車-安寶以及反應敏捷的直昇機-赫利為保護小鎮居民的安全，英勇的救援小隊將同心協力克服困難與危險幫助朋友們！跟著波力一起出發去救援吧！當朋友有需要幫助的時候，救援小隊就會適時地出現，用團隊合作及智慧來解決困難小朋友能從救援小隊幫助別人的行動中，學習日常生活中應該如何小心防範週遭事物，也從中學習到助人為快樂之本的道理以及和平的與他人共處的重要性，是放心讓孩子收看之優質動畫

programme.title: POLI第34集
programme.desc: 在美麗的布魯姆斯小鎮，有一群救援小英雄，分別是富有正義感的警車隊長-波力勇敢又可靠消防車-羅伊善良又聰明的救護車-安寶以及反應敏捷的直昇機-赫利為保護小鎮居民的安全，英勇的救援小隊將同心協力克服困難與危險幫助朋友們！跟著波力一起出發去救援吧！當朋友有需要幫助的時候，救援小隊就會適時地出現，用團隊合作及智慧來解決困難小朋友能從救援小隊幫助別人的行動中，學習日常生活中應該如何小心防範週遭事物，也從中學習到助人為快樂之本的道理以及和平的與他人共處的重要性，是放心讓孩子收看之優質動畫

programme.title: 綜藝新時代第331集

programme.title: 同學！搞什麼鬼第171集
programme.desc: 在校園裡，每個人都可能聽說過或親身經歷過一些離奇又驚人的超自然事件這些故事常常讓人無法置信，即使多年後回想起來仍然令人嘆為觀止年輕的學生總是充滿勇氣，喜歡挑戰成人們認為不應該觸犯的規則和禁忌...

programme.title: 大特寫第203集
programme.desc: 最樸實的大特寫，給你最真實的感動！想認識全台灣好吃好用的農特產？想了解最厲害的養生妙方？想吸收最新奇的產業資訊？就讓主持人侯昌明當你的報馬仔，給你最樸實的大特寫，最真實的感動！

programme.title: 生活1級棒第400集
programme.desc: 生活1級棒是一個兼具生活性趣味性知識性的節目每集都會針對生活中大小事或是稀奇古怪的話題等等做探討，蒐集各種與主題相關的人事物，將邀請達人參與操作，不僅可以看盡生活巧思，更可以增廣見聞，考驗自己的IQ，讓您坐在家中就能知天下事！

programme.title: 妹妹第19集
programme.desc: 周繼薇本來應該叫做周繼偉，是老媽一雪前恥的希望！ 但，當她呱呱落地之後，希望幻滅了，她那被賦予獨一無二的貴子命運，卻瞬間變成了周家第三個女兒所以她只能穿前頭兩個姊姊的舊衣服暗暗嚮往著永遠分不到的魚眼睛因為一隻魚只有兩隻眼睛一隻雞也只有兩隻腿，因此第三個的意思，就是多出來的那個但，多出來的周繼薇，卻深獲鄰居戴奶奶的喜愛，於是，她總是離家出走直奔戴家的懷抱在好乾淨好舒服的戴家，她是一個被愛包圍的小公主，還有一個帥氣的小哥哥戴耀起雖然，戴耀起根本不想有一個妹妹來跟他分食人間美味魚眼睛 想盡辦法要變成戴耀起的妹妹的周繼薇，終於在17歲那年，發現了一個連自

programme.desc: 介紹台灣在地食材的故事，也是台灣最深刻的人生故事故事的主角們，有的為著有機農業奮鬥打拼，為這片土地奉獻青春與血汗有的則是經過千百次的調味與嚐試，只為了成就一道美味料理對比著經營者與料理人的故事，他們或是為生活中年轉業或是離鄉背井追尋夢想，人生路上各自遭逢百轉千折的衝突與適應，才能在逆境中成功蛻變

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒第6集
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子，含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.desc: 天王食品會長家最小的獨生女歐若拉對完美挑剔男作家黃瑪瑪一見鍾情後，便隱瞞自己身分，展開一連串倒追行動

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒第8集
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子，含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 何以笙簫默第26集
programme.desc: 大學時代的趙默笙，對法學系大才子何以琛一見傾心，開朗直率的她死纏爛打地倒追，與眾不同的方式吸引了以琛的目光，一段純純的校園愛情悄悄滋生 然而，以琛寄養家庭的妹妹以玫，鼓起勇氣向默笙宣戰當默笙去找以琛證實，沒想到竟然得到以琛冷酷的回應誤以為以琛和以玫在一起的默笙，落寞地服從父親的安排，前往美國深造七年後，成為攝影師的默笙回來了，再次遇到那個無法忘卻的男人

programme.title: 書卷一夢第16集
programme.desc: 18線女演員宋小魚意外穿越，成為劇本中必死的虐戀女主角宋一夢在大婚當天，她先是被千羽軍攔截，又被魔頭皇子南珩糾纏，三人陷入混亂的互刺局面為了逃避淒慘的命運，宋小魚嘗試反套路悔婚，卻導致系統Bug，深陷離奇死法的無限循環她必須在南珩的身邊，不斷挑戰並改變原本的虐心劇情

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產第2集
programme.desc: 善良的恩星沒有心機，是個樂天派，但同時卻也很倔強十一歲時媽媽去世，在她堅強的外表下，其實常常感到孤單和空虛十六歲時由於爸爸再婚組成了新的家庭，然而繼母和妹妹的態度，讓她對家不再抱有希望愛吃東西的她，對於味覺異常敏銳，進而也對料理產生了興趣一個偶然的機會下，她救了食品財團的張淑子會長，因而成為遺產繼承人，從此她的人生有了新的變化

programme.title: 神鎗手
programme.desc: 戰爭，不在戰場，在人心；仁義，邪惡，一念之間方克明是警隊中最精銳的狙擊手，在機緣下巧遇一名軍裝警察Ｏ仔，並邀他加入狙擊手部隊Ｏ仔入隊後誓要成為首席神槍手然而，神槍手榜中竟然還有一個傳奇人物 凌靖，曾經壓倒方克明，高據榜首四年，但目前卻身陷牢獄中凌靖出獄後，即策動反擊，暗中協助悍匪，攻擊囚車並救出歹徒的首領，之後又與歹徒合作計畫一樁兩億元大劫案！但凌靖的真正目標卻是要挑戰方克明與其領導的狙擊手部隊，準備單槍匹馬把狙擊手全隊打敗而年少氣盛的Ｏ仔則一心希望與高手過招，與凌靖一決高下 前首席神槍手凌靖為何變成階下囚？為何又要挑戰方克明與狙擊手部隊？三位神槍手，各有所思，帶著恩怨情仇

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳
programme.desc: 1991雷洛初到香港，學識不多，決加入警隊為生後認識在雷路上扶助良多的兩個人－豬油仔，他出身低下層社會，對黑道上人仕謀生技倆了如指掌，時常灌輸雷這方面的知識，對雷裨益不少老差骨陳統，他慧眼識英雄，對雷亦師亦友，後更提攜他為探員，成為總華探長的踏腳石初生之犢不畏虎，雷初出道一身傲骨，並不同流合污，成為眾矢之的，其間邂逅少女霞，共墮愛河，但為霞父極力反對，致難成連理

programme.title: 賭霸
programme.desc: 洪光秦沛飾為了一雪前恥，邀請中國特異功能大師嚴真劉洵飾傳授特異功能，並再舉辨第二屆的世界賭王大賽和左頌星再決一高下台灣松劉鎮偉飾因左頌星無故失蹤，轉而逼妹頭代左頌星出戰，妹頭拒絕出賽三叔無奈之聽從賣魚盛元奎飾之勸，從魚欄請得賭術高手霸姐鄭裕玲飾原來霸姐只是為了其弟的手術費而充當老千騙財，此事最後被三叔發覺三叔唯有與霸姐用盡千方百計，務求能妹頭回心轉意幫助霸姐

programme.title: 拆彈專家2
programme.desc: 香港發生了一系列爆炸事件，讓整個城市陷入恐慌前拆彈專家潘乘風（由劉德華飾演）在事發現場昏迷，隨即被警方視為主要嫌疑人，懷疑他與邪惡組織復生會有著密切的聯繫甦醒後，潘乘風面對警方的強力詢問和可能的入獄風險，決定逃離現場，親自查明真相在這條孤獨無援的道路上，他找到昔日戰友拆彈專家董卓文（由劉青雲飾演）請求協助，但由於他們陷入了複雜的黑白不分的境地，董卓文不得不在公與私之間做出艱難的選擇基於他們生死之交的情誼，董卓文最終決定伸出援手同時，潘乘風的前女友龐玲（倪妮飾）現任反恐特勤隊總督察，急於查明爆炸事件的背後真相，以保障市民安全她說服潘乘風接觸復生會，追踪這個神秘組織的下一步恐

programme.title: 雞不可失
programme.desc: 韓國影史最賣座喜劇雞不可失電影從頭到尾精心鋪陳笑點，不僅讓觀眾笑開懷成為紓壓首選，由影帝柳承龍性感女星李哈妮實力派演員陳善圭新生代男星李東輝和當紅小鮮肉孔明共組的魯蛇緝毒組，搞笑毫無包袱認真又可愛的模樣更獲得廣大觀眾喜愛大受歡迎的喜劇雞不可失不只紅了炸雞，魯蛇緝毒組的成員們也跟著人氣飆升，讓影迷看完電影上網狂搜其中戲裡擁有黑皮膚小鬍子的李東輝和熱血呆萌的菜鳥孔明，戲外竟分別是眼鏡潮男和鮮肉花美男，真面目讓影迷又驚又喜引起瘋狂爆笑好評及無敵炸雞旋風的超強喜劇電影雞不可失巧妙運用了草根精神與不被看好的小人物趣味設定，來讓普遍觀眾都能感同身受，融合了動作人物笑聲和感動，

programme.title: 我是誰
programme.desc: Jackie 是美國中情局幹員,授命到南非進行秘密任務,綁走三名科學家以及新發現能源--魔岩.但Jackie的上司摩根竟將所有部屬滅口,武裝直昇機在空中爆炸,除了Jackie受重傷之外,所有的突擊隊員全部喪生. 受重傷且失憶的Jackie被南非當地的巫師救起,Jackie入境隨俗地打扮似非洲戰士,與非洲人民共同生活.有一天Jackie遇上一些參加越野賽車選手的賽車被撞毀,便驅前搭救.賽車選手小雪為了感恩,順道送Jackie到開普敦去求救一名專治失憶症的名醫. Jackie上司摩根知道Jackie生還消息,他立刻派人殺Jackie滅口.此時一位金髮美女克莉絲汀自稱是記者,願幫Jackie恢復

programme.title: 怪獸8號第22集

programme.title: 賭城風雲3
programme.desc: 國際刑警發現石一堅與小馬名下有一個秘密帳戶，該帳戶上有來自DOA集團的150億匯款，因而懷疑兩人私吞贓款，並將他們逮捕隨後，在陳刀仔高進的表妹高菲及龍五之子龍十五的援助下，兩人得以逃脫之後，易天行帶著部下金衣上門邀請陳刀仔與高進參加一場在泰國天堂島舉行的慈善賭局，石一堅假裝成高進和陳刀仔一起前往，卻意外發現他的摯愛莫愁竟出現在高科技研究室裡

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: 老丁（洪金寶 飾）曾是個功力深厚的軍人，但退休後，他過著深藏不露的生活，一回帶外孫女到公園玩時，竟讓外孫女走失，家人難以釋懷，他更極度自責，讓他大受打擊而記憶開始衰退 老丁獨自搬走，在東北的邊境城市生活，鄰居李政久（劉德華 飾）的女兒小春花（陳沛妍 飾）因家庭不睦，常跑到他家避難，勾起了他對外孫女的記憶，兩人成了忘年之交 但李政久卻捲入俄羅斯黑幫的爭鬥，還波及家人，小春花更被綁走，老丁決定挺身而出，尋回身為軍人的驕傲及彌補身為爺爺的過錯

programme.title: 替屍鬼2-詛咒再臨
programme.desc: 玲和姮是一對分散多年的好友，某天，玲收到姮的邀請，前往郊區一間老房子拜訪她玲在房子裡發現傳說中含冤而死的女鬼慕依的畫像，姮因此意外遭到附身而性格大變，出現各種失序的行為為了拯救好友，玲必須解開畫像背後的秘密

programme.title: 新暫時停止呼吸
programme.desc: 靈幻道士英叔（林正英）的舊情人蓮妹，託其妹念英求援，師徒來到大帥府，見大帥身染屍毒，而身懷六甲的蓮，體中胎兒非常怪異，英發覺其褓姆並非常人，於是想引魔胎離開母體，加以消滅，但褓姆拼死護胎，英進退兩難之際，廣西殭屍群跟蹤而來，令眾人腹背受敵，一場殭屍魔胎的大戰就此展開...

programme.title: 車手
programme.desc: 隱形車隊是香港警務處交通部的精英隊伍，熱血滿腦的隱形戰車司機陳翔（余文樂）與拍擋盧峰（黃秋生）因為互不對盤，經常使得任務失敗收場在一次執勤中，陳翔竟輕易地緝拿了黑道傳奇車手蔣薪（郭曉冬），讓盧峰覺得有內情原來他打算入警署羈留室救友，最後更讓他逃之夭夭

programme.title: 臭屁王
programme.desc: 臭屁文在爸爸的婚禮上，捉弄得新媽媽衣不蔽體，因此遭到父親嚴厲的處罰臭屁文決定離家出走，達叔收留他，達叔是一所高中的工友，他暗戀一名賣花的肓女，一心想要幫助她，卻文沒有能力達叔任職的學校是一所全市聞名的爛校，尤其三年八班題名昭彰，學生頭頭破壞王，古靈精怪，鬼點子一大堆，偏偏色大膽小，鍾情於同班的阿珍沒人治得了三八班，校長不得己出榜招賢，賞金五十萬達叔本連想都不敢想，但聽說眼角膜移植恰需五十萬元，正好可替肓女醫病，不禁心動臭屁文有個朋友，乃是千年怪寺烏龍寺的入門弟子，經由他的引薦，達叔得以向老和尚學習武功，以對付調皮搗蛋的學生們達叔藝成出寺，應聘為導師，整得三年八

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 九品後補知縣包龍星（周星馳）辦案能力不足，深受百姓唾棄此時戚家發生滅門慘案，倖存的戚秦氏指認常威為兇手，但常威之父水師提督常昆運用權勢誣陷戚秦氏為犯人，而星亦被調離此案當夜星與其侄有為回兇案現場找證據翻案，反而被打入大牢星逃獄後決心替戚秦氏洗刷冤屈，隨一雜技團上京告御狀

programme.desc: 劇情描述中，遭雷擊的阿綸（柯震東 飾）來到了陰間，所有生前的記憶瞬間消失他面臨著一個抉擇：是要投胎再生，還是成為神職人員？最終，阿綸選擇了成為月老的新手，與性格火爆的粉紅女Pinky（王淨 飾）組成搭檔，前往人間執行任務當阿綸遇見狗狗阿魯和它的主人小咪時，他的前世記憶回潮，小咪（宋芸樺 飾）正是他生前的摯愛
